review_scope: SOC, power/energy, reserve and terminal-condition assumptions
adversarial_case: Incorrect units; depleted initial battery; incompatible annual and hourly models
acceptance: Flag invalid assumptions and demand a reproducible engine-specific run.

review_scope: Cash-flow definitions, discount basis and covenant evidence
adversarial_case: No debt; negative CFADS; nonconventional cash flows; missing revenue bridge
acceptance: Keep undefined metrics null and refuse automatic investment approval.

review_scope: Dated market evidence, settlement intervals and jurisdiction
adversarial_case: Synthetic price called live; publication date treated as effective date
acceptance: Separate observed data from scenario assumptions and legal interpretation.

review_scope: System boundary, emissions factors and provenance
adversarial_case: Missing EPD; mixed lifecycle boundaries; stored-energy provenance absent
acceptance: State scope and uncertainty; do not invent carbon credits.

adversarial_case: Study-only architecture submitted as solved; DC label implies unsupported DC physics
acceptance: Distinguish structural illustration, hourly screen and specialized study.

adversarial_case: Reload after partial progress; guessed self-check; export without learner identity
acceptance: Support learning evidence without claiming accredited mastery.

review_scope: Keyboard, semantics, alternate representations and motion
adversarial_case: Canvas-only information; focus trap; hidden controls; inaccessible heatmap
acceptance: Require task completion with assistive technology, not axe alone.

review_scope: Versioned inputs, model, seed, source and evidence chain
adversarial_case: Tampered input; old schema; missing seed; different engine under same label
acceptance: Require replayable inputs and explicit uncertainty/identity limitations.

review_scope: Conflicts, missing evidence and unsupported conclusions
adversarial_case: All specialists agree despite missing evidence; partial role failure
acceptance: Retain dissent and fail incomplete reviews; human approval remains separate.
